LanguageData.CC_TownAfter_LetterIntro_Tribal_2: {TOWN}'s messenger recited what {HEAD}, {TITLE} of the hearth there, had given them to say:
LanguageData.CC_TownAfter_LetterIntro_Tribal_3: A messenger came in from {TOWN} with words learned by heart from {HEAD}, {TITLE} of the hearth:
LanguageData.CC_TownAfter_LetterIntro_Medieval_2: A letter came from {TOWN} by their messenger, in the hand of {HEAD}, {TITLE} of the town:
LanguageData.CC_TownAfter_LetterIntro_Medieval_3: {HEAD}, {TITLE} of {TOWN}, sent a letter by their messenger, folded and sealed in the old way:
LanguageData.CC_TownAfter_LetterIntro_Industrial_2: A courier from {TOWN} handed over a letter from {HEAD}, {TITLE} of the township, typed and signed:
LanguageData.CC_TownAfter_LetterIntro_Industrial_3: {HEAD}, {TITLE} of the township at {TOWN}, sent a letter by courier:
LanguageData.CC_TownAfter_LetterIntro_Spacer_2: Comms logged a message from {TOWN}, signed by {HEAD}, {TITLE} of the colony there:
LanguageData.CC_TownAfter_LetterIntro_Spacer_3: {HEAD}, {TITLE} at {TOWN}, sent a message over comms:
LanguageData.CC_TownAfter_LetterIntro_Word_2: News reached the colony from {TOWN}, with a few words from {HEAD}, {TITLE} there:
LanguageData.CC_TownAfter_LetterIntro_Word_3: From {TOWN}, by way of travelers on the road, came word from {HEAD}, {TITLE} there:
LanguageData.CC_TownAfter_HomeText_2: {PAWN_nameDef} of {TOWN}, once one of the colony's own, has sent word asking to come home to the colony.
LanguageData.CC_TownAfter_HomeText_3: Word has come from {TOWN}: {PAWN_nameDef}, who was one of the colony's own, wants to come home.
LanguageData.CC_TownLife_AskBackText_2: {HEAD} has sent word from {TOWN} by {MEANS}: the town would come back to the colony, if the colony will have it. {PEOPLE} have had a hard time on their own, and would rather be {COLONY} again.
LanguageData.CC_TownLife_AskBackText_3: By {MEANS} from {TOWN}: times are hard there, and {HEAD} asks, for {PEOPLE}, whether the colony would take {TOWN} back as {COLONY} once more.
LanguageData.CC_TownLife_GateText_2: {TOWN} is given up: {PEOPLE} could not hold on there, and the town that was {COLONY} is a ruin now.
LanguageData.CC_TownLife_GateText_3: {PEOPLE} have left {TOWN}, and the place that was {COLONY} stands empty, a ruin on the map.
LanguageData.CC_TownLife_HardshipText_2: {TOWN} sends word by {MEANS}: {PAWN} has died {WHAT}. {PAWN} was one of the colony's own, and stayed when {COLONY} was handed over.\n\n{TOWN} mourns them.
LanguageData.CC_TownLife_HardshipText_3: By {MEANS}, sad news from {TOWN}: {PAWN}, who stayed when {COLONY} was handed over, has died {WHAT}.\n\n{TOWN} mourns them.
LanguageData.CC_TownLife_CoolHead_2: {TOWN} has a new {TITLE}, {HEAD}, who thinks little of the colony. While {HEAD} leads, the town will be cooler to it.
LanguageData.CC_TownLife_CoolHead_3: {HEAD} is {TITLE} of {TOWN} now, and no friend of the colony's. The town will be cooler to the colony while they lead it.
LanguageData.CC_TownLife_FightText_2: {NAMES} have reached {TOWN} for the colony. {ENEMY} are coming in at the far side, and {PEOPLE} are holding their walls.\n\nIt is their town now: the colony's fighters fight beside its people, not over them. Every raider down or gone, and {TOWN} stands.
LanguageData.CC_TownLife_FightText_3: The colony's fighters, {NAMES}, are at {TOWN}, with {PEOPLE} on the walls beside them and {ENEMY} coming in from the far side.\n\nThe town is its people's, and the colony's fighters are there to help, not to command. Every raider down or gone, and {TOWN} stands.
LanguageData.CC_Found_LetterText_3: {PLACE} is a colony now, founded by {NAMES} from {MOTHER}: {PARTY}.
LanguageData.CC_Found_NewcomersText_2: Answering {CALL}, {NAMES} have come to {PLACE}. They walk in from the edge of the land with what they brought.
LanguageData.CC_Found_NewcomersText_3: {NAMES} are here, answering {CALL}, and walk in to {PLACE} from the edge of the land with what they brought.
LanguageData.CC_Found_NewcomersFoundText_2: Answering {CALL} from {MOTHER}, {NAMES} have come to found {PLACE}. They walk in from the edge of the land with what they brought.
LanguageData.CC_Found_NewcomersFoundText_3: {PLACE} will be founded by {NAMES}, who answered {CALL} from {MOTHER}. They walk in from the edge of the land with what they brought.
LanguageData.CC_HandOver_LetterText_2: {HOME} stands on its own now, the town of the {PEOPLE}, with {HEAD} as its {TITLE}. Those who stayed: {NAMES}.
LanguageData.CC_HandOver_LetterText_3: The colony has handed {HOME} over: it is the town of the {PEOPLE} now, the colony's former people, led by {HEAD} as {TITLE}. Those who stayed: {NAMES}.
LanguageData.CC_TownAfter_BackText_2: By the word of {HEAD} and {PEOPLE}, {TOWN} is the colony's home again: {FORM}.
LanguageData.CC_TownAfter_BackText_3: {TOWN} has come back to the colony: {FORM}, as {HEAD} and {PEOPLE} agreed.
LanguageData.CC_Many_MergedText_2: {NAMES}, the people of {OLD}, have lived a day at {PLACE}, and the two councils are one now.
LanguageData.CC_Many_MergedText_3: A day after the people of {OLD} ({NAMES}) came to live at {PLACE}, its council and theirs are one.
